observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 108.» (L15) and «p. 109.» (L36) in the left margin. The count of the lines runs through the space and the head of chapter 34: 25 stands between the head and the title, beside no line, and 30 beside the first line of the chapter.
body L22-L25: the head «CAPUT XXXIV.» is centred; the title is set in the larger type as a paragraph of three lines, the second and the third indented, not centred.
body L2: the last letter of «quaere» is printed broken, its bar and the left of its bowl not printed; it is read as e.
body L19: the o of «eodem» is printed broken.
body L14, L36: specks stand over the h of «ādhār» and over the first u of «residuum»; they are not signs.
notes_left L3: the letter of «adnot. c» is bold italic.

transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
